packs.title: Godot node icons
packs.author: pixel-boy
notes: Six variants: color, control, node, node_2D, node_3D, and white.
648 icons are 16x16; the five icon_reset_2.png variants are 10x12.
Useful for HUD buttons, status icons, build tools, save/pause, zoom, health, and resources.
Originally designed for Godot editor nodes; the pack is a UI icon library rather than a complete map tileset.

packs.title: Keyboard and controller keys (new)
packs.author: Hyohnoo
notes: Four 256x256 keyboard sheets in black/white and alternative font styles.
Three 320x320 controller sheets: PS4, Xbox 360, and Xbox One.
Individual key graphics vary from 16x16 to 64x16; sheets are not a uniform one-icon-per-cell atlas.
Best suited to graphical tutorial and keyboard-control prompts.

packs.title: Keyboard and controller keys (legacy)
packs.author: Hyohnoo
notes: Two 256x256 sheets: Keyboard Buttons and Xbox Buttons.
A distinct older release; retained separately from the newer download.

packs.title: Urizen tilesets
packs.author: vurmux
notes: Main atlas: 2679x651 pixels. Publisher describes over 5500 12x12 tiles across multiple themes.
Main atlas uses a 13-pixel grid: 12x12 tiles, one-pixel gutters, one-pixel initial margin; 206 columns and 50 rows.
Four 12-pixel-wide magenta guide bands occupy zero-based tile columns 25, 51, 77, and 103; exclude these when choosing sprites.
Contains terrain, doors, walls, furniture, items, machinery, sci-fi equipment, characters, symbols, and bitmap lettering.
Free 2-bit sample: 261x92 pixels, on the same 12x12 / 13-pixel pitch layout; 20 columns and 7 rows.
Both are full-color RGBA PNG atlases. The 1-bit and 2-bit names describe the art style, not the PNG bit depth.
Strongest source for a future graphical Regolith map; the two-bit file is a limited showcase.

suggested_regolith_usage.map_grid: 12x12 tiles; start at (1,1), advance 13 pixels per column/row
